cities.nearest_airport: Lal Bahadur Shastri International Airport, Varanasi

places.name: Kashi Vishwanath Temple
places.ai_summary: One of the most famous Hindu temples dedicated to Lord Shiva, located in the heart of Varanasi.

opening_hours.notes: Special poojas during Shivratri.

places.place_tip: Avoid peak hours to experience the temple peacefully.
places.address: Kashi Vishwanath Temple, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India

places.name: Dashashwamedh Ghat (Ganga Aarti)
places.ai_summary: The most spectacular ghat in Varanasi, known for its evening Ganga Aarti ceremony.

opening_hours.notes: Ganga Aarti starts at 6:30 PM daily.

places.place_tip: Arrive early to secure a good spot for the Aarti.
places.address: Dashashwamedh Ghat, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India

places.name: Assi Ghat
places.ai_summary: A serene ghat located at the confluence of the Ganges and Assi rivers, popular among tourists and locals alike.

opening_hours.notes: Morning yoga sessions are popular here.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a boat ride from this ghat.
places.address: Assi Ghat, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India

attribution.title: Assi Ghat Varanasi morning Aarti
attribution.author: Titodutta
attribution.usage_terms: Creative Commons Zero, Public Domain Dedication

places.name: Manikarnika Ghat
places.ai_summary: The main cremation ghat in Varanasi, an important pilgrimage site for Hindus.

opening_hours.notes: Best to visit in the early morning or evening.

places.place_tip: Maintain a respectful demeanor as this is a sacred site.
places.address: Manikarnika Ghat, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India

attribution.title: Manikarnika Ghat, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India (2011) 5
attribution.author: Aleksandr Zykov from Russia

places.name: Sarnath Archaeological Site & Museum
places.ai_summary: The site where Buddha gave his first sermon, featuring ancient stupas and a museum.

opening_hours.notes: Visit the museum to see the Ashoka Pillar and other artifacts.

places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to the nearby Deer Park.
places.address: Sarnath, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India

attribution.title: Sarnath Museum Front
attribution.author: सत्यम् मिश्र
attribution.description: Front view of the Sarnath Museum

places.name: Ramnagar Fort
places.ai_summary: A fort situated on the banks of the Ganges, known for its museum and panoramic views.

opening_hours.notes: Check for special events or closures.

places.place_tip: Explore the museum and enjoy the views from the fort.
places.address: Ramnagar Fort, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India

attribution.title: Entrance area of Ramnagar Fort
attribution.author: Sidhiwasi

places.name: Banaras Hindu University & Bharat Kala Bhavan
places.ai_summary: A prestigious university with a museum showcasing Indian art, sculpture, and paintings.
places.name_english: Banaras Hindu University & Bharat Kala Bhavan

opening_hours.notes: Visit the museum for its collection of Indian paintings.

places.place_tip: Explore the university campus and the museum.
places.address: Banaras Hindu University, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India

attribution.author: Jeff Hart from Bloomington, IN, USA
attribution.description: Bharat Kala Bhavan Museum, Varanasi Hindu University

places.name: Tulsi Manas Temple
places.ai_summary: A beautiful temple dedicated to Lord Rama, known for its stunning architecture and serene surroundings.

opening_hours.notes: Participate in the evening aarti for a spiritual experience.

places.place_tip: The temple is made of white marble and is very peaceful.
places.address: Tulsi Manas Temple, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India

attribution.title: Manas Mandir
attribution.author: Nikhil399792
attribution.description: A hindu god temple  established in 1950 by the president of India Dr. Rajendra Prasad

places.name: Durga Kund Temple
places.ai_summary: An ancient temple dedicated to Goddess Durga, known for its beautiful pond and peaceful ambiance.

opening_hours.notes: The temple is located near the Durga Kund (pond).

places.place_tip: Visit during the Navaratri festival for special celebrations.
places.address: Durga Kund Temple, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India

attribution.title: Durga Temple gate
attribution.author: AKS.9955
attribution.description: Main enterance of Durga Temple (Durga Mandir) in Varanasi

places.name: New Vishwanath Temple (BHU)
places.ai_summary: A modern temple located within the Banaras Hindu University campus, dedicated to Lord Shiva.

opening_hours.notes: The temple is inside the BHU campus; visitor entry is from the BHU gate.

places.place_tip: The temple is known for its beautiful architecture and peaceful environment.
places.address: New Vishwanath Temple, Banaras Hindu University, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India

places.name: Alamgir Mosque
places.ai_summary: A historic mosque in Varanasi, known for its impressive architecture and serene courtyard.

opening_hours.notes: Respect the prayer times; visit during non-prayer hours.

places.place_tip: The mosque is beautifully lit up in the evening.
places.address: Alamgir Mosque, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India

places.name: Kedar Ghat
places.ai_summary: A peaceful ghat known for its association with Lord Shiva and its tranquil atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Less crowded than other ghats, ideal for meditation.

places.place_tip: A great spot for photography and solitude.
places.address: Kedar Ghat, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India

places.name: Harishchandra Ghat
places.ai_summary: One of the oldest ghats in Varanasi, associated with Hindu cremation rituals.

opening_hours.notes: Visit in the evening to see the cremation rituals.

places.place_tip: Maintain a respectful distance during rituals.
places.address: Harishchandra Ghat, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India

places.name: Nepali Temple (Kathwala Temple)
places.ai_summary: A unique temple built in the Nepali style of architecture, dedicated to Lord Shiva.

opening_hours.notes: The temple is small but architecturally significant.

places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to the nearby Man Mandir Observatory.
places.address: Nepali Temple, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India

places.name: Man Mandir Observatory
places.ai_summary: An ancient observatory built by Maharaja Jai Singh II of Jaipur, featuring a large sundial.

opening_hours.notes: Best to visit in the early morning.

places.place_tip: The observatory offers a great view of the Ganges.
places.address: Man Mandir Observatory, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India

places.name: Munshi & Darbhanga Ghats
places.ai_summary: Two adjacent ghats known for their historical significance and architectural features.

opening_hours.notes: Less crowded, ideal for a peaceful visit.

places.place_tip: Explore the intricate carvings and take a boat ride.
places.address: Munshi & Darbhanga Ghats, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India

places.name: Bharat Mata Temple
places.ai_summary: A unique temple dedicated to Mother India, featuring a map of undivided India carved out of marble.

opening_hours.notes: The temple is closed during the afternoon.

places.place_tip: The temple is located near the Varanasi Junction railway station.
places.address: Bharat Mata Temple, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India

places.name: Weavers’ District – Silk Workshops
places.ai_summary: A vibrant area where you can see traditional silk weaving and shop for silk products.

opening_hours.notes: Visit the workshops to see the weaving process.

places.place_tip: Don't forget to bargain while shopping for silk products.
places.address: Weavers’ District, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India

places.name: Boat Ride on the Ganges (Sunrise/Sunset)
places.ai_summary: A memorable boat ride on the Ganges, offering stunning views of the sunrise or sunset.

opening_hours.notes: Book a boat in advance for sunrise or sunset rides.

places.place_tip: A boat ride is a must-do activity in Varanasi.
places.address: Ganges River, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India

places.name: Godowlia Market
places.ai_summary: The main market area in Varanasi, bustling with activity and a great place to shop for local goods.

opening_hours.notes: Best to visit in the morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Explore the narrow lanes and try the local street food.
places.address: Godowlia Market, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India
